label: EVENT_01_010
text:
So you're the new researcher?
I appreciate you coming along.
I'm Burnet!
I research dreams.
As part of that research,
I'm investigating a certain place.
I'm really fascinated by something
I saw there--the mystery Pokémon!

label: EVENT_01_030
text:
So! I want you to help me
with my research! Whatcha think?
Try tapping Start Search
on the device in your hand.

label: EVENT_16_010
text:
OK! Now we're ready.
Let's be on our way!

label: EVENT_28_010
text:
If Dream Clouds and Dream
Orbs are moving quickly, set
the Nintendo 3DS system
on a flat horizontal surface
for a short amount of time
to return them to normal.

label: EVENT_02_010
text:
Hold the Nintendo 3DS system
in front of you, and move carefully.

label: EVENT_03_010
text:
Hee hee! So, whatcha think?I had you dive right in
without an explanation, but...
right now, you're looking at the
space between dreams and reality.
It's called the Interdream Zone.
Let's start by having a look around!

label: EVENT_03_020
text:
Move the Nintendo 3DS system
around to look at your surroundings.

label: EVENT_04_010
text:
So, you see a fluffy object floating
there like a cloud, right?
That's a Dream Cloud!They materialize in different cycles
and create energy.
And what I'd like you to help me
with is collecting that energy!
I want you to gather the Dream
Orbs made by the Dream Clouds.
So, whatcha think?
I'll tell you how to gather them...
Could you align the crosshairs with
a cloud in the center of the screen?
When a cloud is in your sights,
press !

label: EVENT_05_010
text:
Well, how about that?
You're amazing!
That Beam isn't exactly easy
to get the hang of, but...
not only were you blasting away with
ease, but your aim was spot on, too!
Can you keep it up and hit the
remaining clouds with the Beam?
The number of clouds left is next to
the cloud icon on the Touch Screen.
Oh yeah! The orbs coming from the
clouds are called Dream Orbs.
To gather them, hit them with
the Beam.
Use , just like before.

label: EVENT_06_010
text:
Could it be? That light might
be a Pokémon.
Sometimes Pokémon slip into
the Interdream Zone.
Would you help it out?
You have to catch it first.
Use  to fire the
Beam and stall its movement.
Then, press  repeatedly.Keep hitting it with the Beam
until the meter fills up.
If you take too much time,
it will run away.

label: EVENT_07_020
text:
If you catch a Pokémon, I want
you to return it to the real world.
Could you send the Pokémon you
catch to the Trainer you trust most?

label: EVENT_07_030
text:
Pokémon and items can be sent.After you finish your search,
select Send Research Data.

label: EVENT_32_010
text:
That Pokémon just now! That's it!Wow! Encountering it on your
first search is just amazing!
THAT is the mystery Pokémon
I've been looking for!

label: EVENT_07_010
text:
Great work!I'm so happy to have met you!
I really want your help.
First, let's collect the Dream Orbs
I need for my research!
Dream Clouds usually appear at
a rate of one every five minutes.
They don't form while you're
researching, though.
So visit the Interdream Zone after
many Dream Clouds have appeared.
So, whatcha think? I'll be counting
on you from here out.

label: EVENT_08_010
text:
I want to upgrade the device you're
using, but I need Dream Orbs.
I will be able to make more progress
if I have a lot, so keep 'em coming!

label: EVENT_09_010
text:
Thanks to you, I finally finished
this extension!
With this, you will be able to
find the mystery Pokémon!
I want you to do your best
and catch it!
If anyone can catch a Pokémon
no one has caught before, it's you!
I believe in you!

label: EVENT_10_010
text:
I never would have guessed that
the mystery Pokémon was Tornadus!
I just did a lot of research on
that Tornadus...
The reason it looks different
than it does in the real world is...
it changed its Forme to
match its environment.
I'll call this Forme...Therian Forme!Those other two Pokémon I saw...they must have been Therian Forme
Thundurus and Landorus.
I'll get to work on extensions that
will let you meet those two.
I'll need lots of Dream Orbs,
but you're here, so I'm not worried!
I'm counting on you!
Keep up the good work!

label: EVENT_11_010
text:
I completed the extension!With this, you should be able to
find a Therian Forme Pokémon.
You caught Tornadus, so I'm sure
you'll succeed this time, too!
Good luck!

label: EVENT_12_010
text:
I knew you could do it!What you just caught now is
Therian Forme Thundurus.
What a foreboding appearance!How wonderful! I'm sure researching
Therian Forme Pokémon is important.
It'll be a big part of unlocking the
mysteries of the Interdream Zone.
I'm working on an extension to find
Landorus, but I need Dream Orbs.
I'm counting on you!

label: EVENT_13_010
text:
The extension is ready!If you search with this, the identities
of all the Therian Forme Pokémon...
will finally be clear.I really want you to catch it,
but don't do anything crazy.
I don't want you to get hurt!
I mean...
You're the only one here who is
a decent shot with that Beam.
Kidding...kidding.Sentimental stuff makes me
a little embarrassed.
I mean, you're one of my teammates,
and you're very important to me.
OK. I'm counting on you!
See you when you get back!

label: EVENT_14_010
text:
Welcome back! Thank you so much!
Excellent work!
Therian Forme Landorus!
I can barely take my eyes off it.
What's more, researching these
three Pokémon will not only...
teach us much about the
Interdream Zone...it will also shed light on many
mysteries in the real world as well.
It might change everything we
know about dreams and reality.
What you found for me may be
a clue about a new dimension.
This is a discovery for the
history books.
My research is going to get
even more interesting.
You've really gone above
and beyond for me...
but I'd be really happy if you'd come
help when you have a little time...
like during breaks from your
research or something like that.
I mean, no other researchers have
instincts as good as yours.
Whatcha think? Hee hee.I can't wait to see what you'll
help me discover next!

I came up with something neat...

If you'd like, use them like you'd
use any other search extension.
They need a lot of Dream Orbs

is moving along nicely.
And I completed a new extension!The 촀 makes it

Since I saw the mystery Pokémon...I've been totally absorbed in my
Interdream Zone research.

label: TWEET_00_005
text:
The mystery Pokémon I saw were
different from other lost Pokémon...
They looked as if they were used to
the Interdream Zone.

label: TWEET_01_001
text:
A way to reach the Therian
Forme Pokémon...
I've started data analysis, but
I still need more Dream Orbs.

label: TWEET_01_002
text:
Development is going smoothly
on that extension.
I'm about halfway there.
I'd sure like more Dream Orbs.

label: TWEET_01_003
text:
I'm working on an extension for
catching Therian Forme Pokémon...
Development is moving right along.
I'm over halfway done!

label: TWEET_01_004
text:
Thanks to you, the
촀 is almost done!
I'm making my final adjustments.
I can't wait to see how it turns out!

label: TWEET_01_005
text:
I'd like to have a long look at the
other Therian Forme Pokémon soon!

label: TWEET_01_006
text:
Landorus and Thundurus--
I wonder which is easier to find...

label: TWEET_01_007
text:
Tornadus and the others
seem to love Dream Orbs.
I wonder if normal energy
doesn't satisfy them...

label: TWEET_01_008
text:
Your friend is in the
Unova region, right?
I hear there's a Gym Leader there
called Roxie, and she's really tough!
But I guess when it comes down to
it, I'm a researcher, not a battler!

label: TWEET_01_009
text:
Therian Forme... Don't you think
that name's perfect for them?

label: TWEET_01_010
text:
Thanks for the good work!
You know, the more you think...
"I can still keep going,"
the more you need to rest!
People say that to me a lot, too...

label: TWEET_02_001
text:
I'm developing the extension to
find Therian Forme Landorus, but...
I still need more Dream Orbs.
I'm relying on you!

label: TWEET_02_002
text:
Thanks to you, the extension
development is moving along.
Maybe I'm about halfway done?

label: TWEET_02_003
text:
The 촀's
development is coming along!
I'm more than halfway done, but I
think I need more Dream Orbs.

label: TWEET_02_004
text:
The 촀 is
almost done!
I'm making some last adjustments.
Hee hee! I'm so excited!

label: TWEET_02_005
text:
Thundurus's Therian Forme
was sure surprising, wasn't it?

label: TWEET_02_006
text:
I've made progress in analyzing
Tornadus's and Thundurus's Formes.

label: TWEET_02_007
text:
All that's left is Landorus...
I'll develop an excellent extension!

label: TWEET_02_008
text:
I can find Landorus by using data
from Tornadus and Thundurus.

label: TWEET_02_009
text:
Research never ends.
Take this, for example...
If I didn't know you, I wouldn't
want to know much about you.
But meeting you just once
would create a lot of mysteries...
like what your name is
or what your hobbies are.
I think it's something like that.The more you know, the more
mysteries there are.

label: TWEET_02_010
text:
I'm taking a coffee break.Watching the steam come out
of the cup is soothing, isn't it?

label: TWEET_02_011
text:
I'm shocked how much my research
has progressed since you arrived!

label: TWEET_02_012
text:
You are an amazingly good
Dream Orb gatherer.

label: TWEET_02_013
text:
I really want some fresh air.
Maybe I'll go for a walk.

label: TWEET_02_014
text:
When I think about it...the sun we see is the sun
from eight minutes ago.
The Interdream Zone could also
be further away than it looks, right?

label: TWEET_03_001
text:
Were Landorus and the other two
Pokémon from the Unova region...
or were they born in the
Interdream Zone?

label: TWEET_03_002
text:
Wait... Wasn't Landorus enshrined
somewhere in the Unova region?
Oh, that's right!
It's the Abundant Shrine!

label: TWEET_03_003
text:
I didn't think we could collect all of
the Therian Forme Pokémon's...
data so fast!
It's all thanks to you!

label: TWEET_03_005
text:
The Dream Orb's energy
is astounding, but...
you and I, and everything influence
the space around us just by existing!
Maybe that's an incredible power
as well...

label: TWEET_03_006
text:
My research is moving along!
Science isn't about the absolute...
it's about always moving forward
into the next phase!
That's why it's endlessly fascinating.

label: TWEET_03_007
text:
I didn't want to take the time
to eat, so I made do with coffee...
Doesn't skipping meals just
make you feel ill?
Maybe I should eat something.

label: TWEET_03_008
text:
I've come to understand many
different things through my research.
But what's made clear by science
isn't necessarily the truth...
it's the way to get close to the truth.
That's what I think anyway...

label: TWEET_03_009
text:
It's nice of you to work so hard,
but make sure to get lots of sleep!

label: TWEET_03_010
text:
Are dreams just noise? Or do
they have a vital meaning for us?

label: TWEET_03_011
text:
I think I'll have a little ice cream
to cool my head...
Ice cream... That ice-cream cone
Fennel brought was sure delicious.

label: TWEET_03_012
text:
Maybe the true Forme of Tornadus
and the others is their Forme...
in the Interdream Zone!
But I can't say for sure yet.

label: TWEET_03_013
text:
I've been holed up in the lab,
but look at it like this...
During the time I've been
riding on this planet...
I've traveled thousands of miles
in space!
Pretty active...right?

label: TWEET_03_014
text:
You've been a great help!
Thank you!

label: TWEET_03_015
text:
I feel good leaving those Pokémon
with a Trainer that you trust!
Have you tried sending them
research data yet?
I can't wait to hear about the
adventures those Pokémon have.

label: TWEET_03_016
text:
You definitely gather high-quality
Dream Orbs!

label: TWEET_03_017
text:
Energy that works the same
way as Dream Orbs...
It hasn't been discovered
in the real world yet.

label: TWEET_03_018
text:
Oh! It looks like someone drank the
Shuckle Berry Juice I was chilling.
That's too bad. I wanted you to
try some.

label: TWEET_04_001
text:
My inventions haven't been well
received by the researchers...
It seems something about my
devices is always a little odd.

label: TWEET_04_002
text:
So, I was doing some
experiments on space...
and I made the hole in the donut
vanish into nothing!
So watch out--there might be
a hole somewhere else in its place.

label: TWEET_04_003
text:
Dream Orbs sure look yummy...
That's a pretty color, you betcha!

label: TWEET_04_004
text:
Whatcha think would happen if you
licked a Dream Orb? Kidding!
